meta.title: sigma grid regeneration on today's mesh — old vs new

axes.note: the new grid extends el from 9 to 23 rows; ALL old-vs-new numbers below are computed on the 9 SHARED rows only (apples to apples). The extension rows are reported separately under el_extension.

meta.statistic: headline = sigma_smooth_dbsm (the consumed/quoted array); level = 10log10 linear mean in m^2 (quote_policy)

recompute_verification.purpose: recompute already-computed cells with the production worker and demand bit-identity; the SBR kernel has no RNG (jitter is a deterministic J^2 lattice), so any difference would be a real defect

A_cross_round.claim: base rows (sg_worker, 9 el at once) reproduce exactly under elx_worker (1 el at a time) -- this is the premise that lets the two rounds be merged into one grid

B_reproducibility.claim: extension rows reproduce exactly on re-run

ALL BANDS (new grid, all 23 el rows).note: 23 el rows incl. the extension; no old counterpart, reference only

el_extension.what_it_fixes: the old grid stopped at -20 deg and consumers silently clamped every lookup below that to the -20 deg row; these rows replace the clamp with computed values
